BiblicalUsage: çᵉlîychâh covers pardon, and the Bible uses it the way ordinary people would. You find it 3 times, in Daniel among other places, and each time it is doing the same steady work. It is a word you understand best by watching where it goes, not by guessing at it.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple: pardon is part of how God speaks to us, and çᵉlîychâh is the word He chose for it. That is reason enough to learn it.
